name: theme-provider
title: Theme provider
description: Set and save the theme, accent, font, corners, density and direction from React with useTheme(), and avoid the first-paint flash with themeScript().
a11y: The theme follows the system colour scheme until the user chooses one.
ThemeSwitcher is a labelled group of native selects, fully keyboard operable.
Changing direction also sets dir on the page so arrow keys follow the reading direction.
